en.html:
Kageaki"Do it... Muramasa! Nobody is left to protect Hikaru now."
Muramasa《B-but... I can't—without you!》
Kageaki"What are you short of? Arms and legs? A heart? Heat?"
Kageaki"All here. Once this troublesome mind is killed, the body left behind is entirely yours..."
Kageaki"USE IT!"

en.html:
...Yes.
This is the equation for defeating Hikaru Minato—the Silver Star.

Kill the self: ga. Become nothing: mu. Strike down the enemy.

Muga. No-self.

A hero with no self can kill the demon king and save the world.

Don't forget, okay?
Think properly about what it MEANS.

Mido.

...Just once, you can allow it, na?
Really, I wanted to call you that.

ja.html:
……そう。
　これが湊斗光――銀星号打倒の方程式。

　<ruby>我<rt>ガ</rt></ruby>を殺し、<ruby>無<rt>ム</rt></ruby>となって敵を討つ。

　無我の理念。

　英雄は無我なれば魔王を殺し世界を救う。

　忘れないで。
　<ruby>意味<rt>・・</rt></ruby>を良く考えてね。

　御堂。

　……一度くらい、いいでしょ？
　本当は、こう呼ばせて欲しかったんだ。
